layout: 'Refund on order 204-…': 'processing your refund in the amount of £849.00 for your Order …', the item and the reason
text:
Dear Customer,

Greetings from Amazon.co.uk.

We are writing to confirm that we are processing your refund in the amount of £849.00 for your Order 204-9998887-7776665.

This refund is for the following item(s):

Item: Lumio 14-inch Laptop, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
Quantity: 1
Reason for refund: Damaged during transit

Item Refund: £707.50
Item Tax Refund: £141.50

MasterCard Credit Card [expiring on 3/2027]: £849.00

notPurchase.why: Review, 25 Nov 2026: the email says the refund is being processed, not that it has been made, so it is read as a refund under way (stage refunding), never as refunded.
